The additional impact of Rs 7,335.63 lakhs (including legal and professional fees and tax-related expenses) was recognised as an exceptional item during the half year ended September 30, 2026, comprising Rs 7,144.05 lakhs in the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and Rs 191.58 lakhs in the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Subsequent to the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, the Income Tax Department, of the Income Tax Act, 2025, at certain offices of the Company, as well as at the residences of certain directors from October 7, 2026, to October 14, 2026.
